description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Revaluation option for the property, Plant and Equipment for entities adopting the Sri Lanka Accounting Standard for SMES
reasoning: This gazette content involves the publication of an accounting standard (Statement of Alternative Treatment No. 2) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for financial reporting, specifically addressing measurement standards for property, plant and equipment for SMEs. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it concerns the implementation of statutory instruments and regulatory standards.
